steps.say: I’m Titus—welcome. I’m the agent built into this site, and the whole website is a tool I can use. Let me show you around.

Ask me anything about my work, any time. If you’re hiring, click “I’m hiring — check my fit for a role,” paste the job description, and I’ll tell you honestly how I fit. That button stays in Ask Titus after the tour.
I’m a Lead AI Engineer at Mastercard. I’m picking up my pass and opening the role below.
Each pass is one role; I’m picking up UOB and Illumina, which open below. You can also see every role at once.
To find out more about my education, go here. I have a Master of IT in Business (AI track) from Singapore Management University.
My projects play like films. This one is fictional-bassoon, which I built on my own.
My writing is a newspaper of articles by year and theme, and I can answer questions about any of them. Here are two examples, also in Ask Titus after the tour.
ask: Which of your articles should I read to build production-ready agents?
LoRA, RAFT or GRPO: which fine-tuning approach should I use, and when?

steps.say: On About, my periodic table shows every tool I’ve used, lighting up in the order I picked each one up. Here’s LangGraph.
Want to learn more about me, the copilot? Click here. The colophon shows how I’m built and tested.
This was a recorded run. Ask me anything and watch me drive the site live; “I’m hiring — check my fit for a role” is right below whenever you need it.
